# Minion spell/attack pool separation

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, damage-pool

## Derived / confirmed formula

A spell- or attack-tagged minion damage pool applies ONLY to a matching ability. Spell damage never touches an Attack minion, and vice versa.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified. Deterministic (no in-game number to check) but flagged for completeness.

minion_offense.py _skill_type_ok(tags, is_spell) threaded through _minion_additional + the generic/type increased + flat filters. e.g. minion_spell_dmg_additional excluded from an attack magus.
